g.title: backend-losses
g.text: FP8 KV and decode DeepGEMM losses
Tested each backend on the routed pipeline at matched N52.
Both failed joint SLA; retained BF16 KV and closed those tested
branches. Does not rule out phase-specific use.

99% point gate. Not BTC certification or statistical equivalence.
